description: This file defines the ExpenseType entity class for the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes properties like id, name, description, user, status, and isDeleted, along with their respective getter and setter methods. The class is part of the OrangeHRM Entity namespace and represents an expense type record with relational mapping to a User entity.

classes.name: ExpenseType
classes.description: Entity class representing an expense type in the HRM system, with properties for id, name, description, associated user, status, and soft delete flag, along with getter/setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the expense type.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the expense type.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the expense type.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the expense type.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the expense type, if any.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the expense type.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the User entity associated with this expense type.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Associates a User entity with this expense type.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status flag of the expense type.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status flag of the expense type.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the expense type is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setIsDeleted
methods.description: Marks the expense type as deleted or not.
